shortDescription: According to Wallstreetcn, data released by ship-tracking firm Kpler on August 31 showed that the number of visible commercial vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz over the past weekend fell to five a day because of fears of attack.

title: Visible Commercial Ship Traffic Through Strait of Hormuz Falls to Five Vessels a Day
